name: defile-migration-counts
title: Défilé de l'Écluse migration counts

resources.name: count

fields.name: count_id
fields.description: Readable release identity: era prefix (B notebook, S spreadsheet, N Naturalist, T Trektellen), local YYYYMMDD, optional recorded HHMM, eBird code or normalized original taxon label, optional collision/subgroup suffix, and normal/reverse/local category. Regenerated each build; corrections can change it.

fields.name: source_count_id
fields.description: Original source observation identity, shared by categories and subgroups. Historical workbook sheet/row or Trektellen dataid/export position; links to the internal source ledger. Not a unique key and not regenerated from the readable count ID.

fields.name: survey_id
fields.description: Original survey association, retained even when entry timing is missing or outside the survey interval. A link does not establish interval membership; explicit count datetime takes precedence over survey timing. Missing only when no released source survey is available.

fields.name: taxon_id
fields.description: Bird taxonomy foreign key.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: ISO local collection date, UTC datetime or UTC interval. Empty inherits survey timing; required when no survey is linked. Dates carry no invented midnight. String with an ISO pattern because date/datetime types cannot represent the permitted interval form. Z or +00:00 is required for clock times; the build writes Z. Calendar validity and ordering are checked by the declared ISO rule.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Numerical quantity for this count_category; required except for presence-only count_estimation=x.

fields.name: count_category
fields.description: normal: main migration direction; reverse: opposite direction; local: local/non-migrating birds (Trektellen Present). Missing reverse/local quantities produce no row; explicit zeros are retained. Filter normal for main migration totals.

fields.name: count_estimation
fields.description: Recorded count qualifier. Blank means no recorded qualifier, not proof of exactness. Numeric totals retain the supplied number even when estimated or a lower bound.

>.description: More than the recorded number; a lower bound, not the inferred true total.

x.description: Presence without a numerical count; count must be empty.

fields.name: age
fields.description: Native Trektellen age code or the explicit historical lower-bound code >1y; see source crosswalk. Blank means no supported whole-row class. New codes require a dictionary review.

1.note: Calendar age does not imply juvenile plumage; do not automatically convert to Batumi juv.

3.note: Observed native code; meaning extends the verified 1cy/2cy convention. Confirm full Trektellen dictionary.

4.note: Observed native code; meaning extends the verified 1cy/2cy convention. Confirm full Trektellen dictionary.

I.description: Older than first calendar year; immature
I.note: The UI explicitly shows >1cy (imm); do not use for unspecified older birds or all non-adults.

J.note: No code-to-label evidence recovered; preserve native values, no historical conversion to J yet.

Non-Juv.note: Precise definition unresolved; no automatic older-than-one-year conversion.

Non-adult.note: Both spellings occur; the checked public page did not render the attribute. Preserve source spelling for now.

non_adult.note: Both spellings occur; the checked public page did not render the attribute. Preserve source spelling for now.

>1y.description: Older than one year; adult status unspecified
>1y.note: Dataset extension, not a native Trektellen code. A lower bound in years is not an exact calendar age or an immature/adult classification. Exclude from adult/non-adult proportions.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Trektellen sex code; FC means female type, not necessarily female. Allowed codes are the reviewed inventory; unverified meanings are labelled explicitly. Blank means no supported whole-row class. New codes require a dictionary review.

FC.note: FC does not establish that the bird is female.

fields.name: plumage
fields.description: Native or reviewed Trektellen plumage code; unknown codes remain native. Allowed codes are the reviewed inventory; unverified meanings are labelled explicitly. Blank means no supported whole-row class. New codes require a dictionary review.

W.note: Do not decode from the letter alone or infer a historical mapping.

I.note: Do not decode from the letter alone or infer a historical mapping.

B.note: Do not decode from the letter alone or infer a historical mapping.

E.note: Do not decode from the letter alone or infer a historical mapping.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Residual source prose without field-name prefixes. Fully converted count/age/sex/plumage descriptions and explicit clocks are omitted; unresolved wording, behaviour and source-attributed daily context remain. Original fields are preserved in the internal source ledger.

fields.name: remark_processing
fields.description: Processing explanations, distinct from observer text.

fields.name: trektellen_data_id
fields.description: Native count-entry dataid, not the survey-level countid.

resources.description: One row per count category and supported historical normal-count subgroup, with original source identity and timing. A row may represent several birds.

x-validationRules.description: An unlinked count must supply its own date, datetime or interval.
A numerical count is required unless count_estimation is x.
Presence-only x must have an empty numerical count.
Nonempty count timing is a valid ISO date, datetime or increasing interval; clock times must be UTC.

resources.name: survey

fields.name: survey_id
fields.description: Readable release identity: era prefix (B notebook, S spreadsheet, N Naturalist, T Trektellen, C curated), local YYYYMMDD, recorded start HHMM where available, and optional collision suffix. Calendar-day closures omit time. Regenerated each build; corrections can change it.

fields.name: source_survey_id
fields.description: Original internal survey identity, retained for joins to source audits and reviewed decisions. Trektellen native header ID remains in trektellen_count_id.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: UTC ISO interval. For curated day-precision closures, calendar boundaries identify an unavailable day, not effort hours. Native header timing is retained even when no counting occurred.

fields.name: recording_era
fields.description: notebook, spreadsheet, naturalist or trektellen; historical 2021 is transitional. Curated identifies an added non-counting interval, not a native survey.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Source survey prose and explicit no-species-entry annotation, including historical visitor/person-hour notes.

fields.name: remark_processing
fields.description: Processing notes; historical narratives have day-level scope.

fields.name: trektellen_count_id
fields.description: Native header ID for the Trektellen correction link.

fields.name: observers
fields.description: Names/initials and attendance times as supplied; not quantitative observer effort.

fields.name: weather
fields.description: Recorded weather narrative, preserving changing conditions and qualifiers.

fields.name: wind_speed_bft
fields.description: Wind speed class on the Beaufort scale, 0 (calm) to 12 (hurricane force). Blank is unrecorded; zero can be a real calm reading.

fields.name: wind_direction
fields.description: Native Dutch compass code for the direction from which wind comes; standard 16-point compass plus variable. Codes are retained without translating the stored values.

fields.name: cloud_cover
fields.description: Cloud cover in eighths (oktas): 0 clear, 8 fully covered. Blank is unrecorded; zero can be a real clear-sky reading.

fields.name: cloud_height
fields.description: Native cloud-height value; units and default-zero semantics require confirmation.

fields.name: precipitation
fields.description: Reviewed native weather category, retained verbatim. Fog is recorded in this field despite not being precipitation. Blank is unknown; only geen explicitly records none. Other future categories require a dictionary review.

geen.description: None (Dutch geen): explicit source category, not inferred from a blank.

mist.description: Fog (Dutch mist), not drizzle; retained as a native weather category.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Visibility in metres, supported by the public display (e.g. 8000m). Native zero is retained and can be a default; it is not asserted to be measured zero visibility.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius. Negative values are allowed. Native zeros are retained and may be defaults; no guessed meteorological bounds are imposed.

fields.name: survey_complete
fields.description: true: every bird that passed during the interval is in count.csv. This includes intervals when weather (rain, fog, storm) made counting impossible: no bird is assumed to pass (weather_stop). false: someone was counting but birds are known to have passed uncounted (records lost or deleted, birds noted as missed); rare. Times nobody was counting (absences, days not monitored) are not survey rows.

fields.name: weather_stop
fields.description: true: weather made counting impossible over the whole interval, so its zeros are assumed, not observed. Always with survey_complete true. Blank otherwise. Lets a user test the assumption that no bird passes when counting is impossible, by dropping these rows.

fields.name: survey_comment
fields.description: Short note on the decision for this interval: why it is a weather stop or incomplete, what was cut out of it, or an assumption made. Not the observers' narrative, which stays in remark and weather.

resources.description: Survey intervals: when someone was responsible for the count, including weather stops (complete, no bird). survey_complete says whether the counts hold every bird that passed.

x-validationRules.description: Survey timing is an increasing ISO datetime interval with UTC on both endpoints.
A weather stop is a complete count with no bird.
A weather stop says why in survey_comment.
An incomplete survey says why in survey_comment.

resources.name: taxonomy

fields.name: taxon_id
fields.description: Avibase bird concept ID, including unidentified-bird groups.

fields.name: scientific_name
fields.description: AviList scientific name, with eBird/Clements fallback.

fields.name: english_name
fields.description: Checklist English name: AviList first, with eBird/Clements fallback.

fields.name: taxon_rank
fields.description: Checklist rank or group category; not all concepts are species.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Checklist order.

fields.name: family
fields.description: Checklist family.

fields.name: parent_taxon_id
fields.description: taxon_id of the smallest enclosing group in this table (a 'sp.' or slash taxon, or the species of a subspecies); empty for roots. Curated in taxonomy/parent_taxa.csv. Summing a group's descendants gives all birds counted under it.

fields.name: taxonomy_source
fields.description: Checklist and version used for the concept's scientific name.

fields.name: ebird_code
fields.description: Corresponding eBird/Clements code when available.

fields.name: trektellen_species_id
fields.description: Distinct native species IDs, sorted numerically and comma-separated; empty for historical-only concepts.

fields.name: source_taxa
fields.description: JSON array of source names, native Trektellen species IDs, mapping notes and review labels.

resources.description: One Avibase bird concept, with checklist names and the source-label crosswalk.

resources.name: report_text
resources.description: Accepted French report prose indexed by year, category and key, read from raw/reports/report_text.csv. Species keys are dataset Avibase IDs, including broader taxon concepts. Shared passages are not independent evidence; missing rows do not imply absence. Extraction history is archived and is not part of the build.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Report year.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Account category. Together with year and key, identifies one populated account.

species.description: Taxon accounts; key is an Avibase ID in taxonomy.csv, including species, spuh, slash and hybrid concepts.

site.description: Site history, geography and organisational background. Allowed key: background.

monitoring.description: Monitoring protocol, actual effort/coverage and nocturnal monitoring. Allowed keys: methods, effort, nocturnal.

weather.description: Weather and visibility narrative. Allowed keys: season, july, august, september, october, november, december.

results.description: Seasonal results and interpretation. Allowed keys: overview, highlights, discussion.

outreach.description: Public engagement, school activities and visitor communication. Allowed key: activities.

fields.name: key
fields.description: For category species, an Avibase taxon_id from taxonomy.csv. Otherwise a key allowed for the category, as documented below. Weather uses season or an English month name. The year is the report year, including when prose compares earlier years.

methods.description: Field protocol followed by data processing and analysis, with internal headings.

effort.description: Actual dates/hours, staffing, volunteer availability, coverage gaps and observation-point changes.

nocturnal.description: Acoustic/nocturnal monitoring methods, effort, results and limitations; separate from daytime visual counts.

overview.description: Broad seasonal totals, composition and migration patterns.

highlights.description: Notable events, mixed-species observations, irruptions and records.

discussion.description: Interpretation, longer-term trends, limitations and outlook.

activities.description: School activities, public events, visitor attendance and outreach restrictions.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Non-empty curated French report prose, preserving paragraph breaks.

x-validationRules.description: Species accounts must use Avibase taxon IDs.
Allowed keys for monitoring: methods, effort, nocturnal.
Allowed keys for weather: season, july, august, september, october, november, december.
Allowed keys for results: overview, highlights, discussion.
Every species account key must exist in taxonomy.taxon_id.

resources.name: paper_text
resources.description: Accepted French species accounts from all four Nos Oiseaux papers, read from raw/reports/paper_text.csv. Same category/key/text structure as report_text; source_id distinguishes the two 1996 parts and multi-year syntheses. Species keys follow existing Avibase mappings; three group keys retain shared accounts. Missing accounts do not imply absence. Extraction evidence is archived.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Paper identity (the local reference library lists the documents): 1996 Parts I and II describe 1993; 2019 covers 1993–2017; 2020 covers 1993–2019.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Account category; currently species accounts only.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Accepted Avibase taxon concept or shared group key. Group keys cover freux/choucas, three swallow species, and pomarin/criard eagles. Paper taxa can be absent from the count taxonomy; historical names and mapping notes remain in the extraction archive.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Curated French prose with paragraph breaks, including published status and summary statistics where present. Figures and tables omitted; published discrepancies retained.

temporal_semantics: Clock instants and interval endpoints are UTC (canonical Z). Date-only counts retain the collection calendar date in Europe/Paris. For daily aggregation, convert instants to Europe/Paris before selecting the date.
description: Bird migration counts, surveys including all interruption and protocol evidence, taxonomy and curated annual-report and Nos Oiseaux paper prose at Défilé de l’Écluse.

x-recordingEras.notebook: Historical sheet 1966-2013; digitised daily records; original recording medium not confirmed for every row.
x-recordingEras.spreadsheet: Historical sheet 2014-2016; mainly hourly forms with some daily records.
x-recordingEras.naturalist: Historical sheet 2017-2021; mixed entry and intervals; 2021 is a transition year.
x-recordingEras.trektellen: Native paired exports from 2022; earlier 2021 export is archived, not added twice.
x-recordingEras.curated: Evidence-based non-counting interval outside recorded native survey periods; calendar or bounded times identify the interval, never observed effort.

x-validationNotes: Frictionless validates standard types, constraints, primary keys and foreign keys. x-validationRules declare project rules implemented by the local validator; generic Frictionless validators do not enforce these extensions.
